name: MedXT
long_description: MedXT is the easiest way to manage medical images online.  We make it easy for medical professionals to access and share their medical data safely and securely.  We provide specialty tools such as RIS, PACS, and HL7 connectivity. The MedXT platform will power your imaging center, hospital radiology department, or radiology group. Learn more at https://www.medxt.com
one_liner: Radiology in the cloud.  X-rays, CAT scans, MRI's, and…

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Reshma is CEO of Medplum. In the recent past she was a Visiting Group Partner at YC. Reshma Khilnani was co-founded of MedXT (YC W13 acquired by Box) and Droplet (now Kit.com). Early in her career she held roles at Facebook and Microsoft. Reshma has a BS and MEng from MIT in EECS. She lives in San Francisco and owns reshma.com
